config.statistic: Pre-MASTER pseudo-C_l at ell=1 is computed on the un-monopole-subtracted CW-fraction map (p_CW(n_hat) * mask, NO mean subtraction, hp.anafast at lmax=191 in RING ordering); this exposes the ell=0 monopole leakage into ell=1 through the patchy canonical mask geometry. The hemisphere max|A| statistic is computed on the monopole-subtracted CW-deficit field (p_CW(n_hat) - <p_CW>) * mask, via a 768-direction NSIDE=8 matmul with per-direction hemi-balance normalization, isolating the dipole amplitude after global CW excess is removed. Both observables are mask-coupled; neither is MASTER-deconvolved.
